introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Inhale deeply to lengthen your spine. Exhale slowly to lift your right leg and use your left hand to pull your right knee to the left. Extend your right arm to the side, palm down.

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds. With each exhale, soften and deepen the twist.
name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the twist and relax.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Inhale deeply to lengthen your spine. Exhale slowly to lift your left leg and use your right hand to pull your left knee to the right. Extend your left arm to the side, palm down.

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds. With each exhale, soften and deepen the twist.
name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the twist and relax.

introduce: Put your left hand on your back, use your right hand to grab your left elbow and gently pull it. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: TRICEPS STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please make sure that your elbow is bent to the max.
You should feel a stretch on your triceps.
Please press your left shoulder down when pulling your left elbow.
This workout stretches your triceps and helps improve your shoulder mobility.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Put your right hand on your back, use your left hand to grab your right elbow and gently pull it. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: TRICEPS STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please make sure that your elbow is bent to the max.
You should feel a stretch on your triceps.
Please press your right shoulder down when pulling your right elbow.
This workout stretches your triceps and helps improve your shoulder mobility.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.

Rest one hand behind your head and the other at your side. Bend your torso towards the side where your extended arm is and reach that arm toward the floor.

Pause for one second and return to the starting position. Switch sides and repeat the exercise.
name: STANDING SIDE BEND

tips.text: Please pause for one second when your bend down.
Inhale when you bend down, and exhale when you go back to the starting position.
If it’s too easy for you, you can hold a dumbbell in the hand of your stretched arm.
This exercise works your obliques.

introduce: Stand with your left arm close to a wall. Extend your left arm and put your left hand on the wall, then gently turn your body to the right.
name: STANDING BICEPS STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Breathe naturally.

introduce: Stand with your right arm close to a wall. Extend your right arm and put your right hand on the wall, then gently turn your body to the left.
name: STANDING BICEPS STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Breathe naturally.

introduce: Hold your hands together and lift them overhead. Then move your arms clockwise in big circles.
name: OVERHEAD ARM CLOCKWISE CIRCLES

tips.text: Please focus the movement on your middle and upper back.
Please lift your hands up as much as possible.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Hold your hands together and lift them overhead. Then move your arms counterclockwise in big circles.
name: OVERHEAD ARM COUNTERCLOCKWISE CIRCLES

tips.text: Please focus the movement on your middle and upper back.
Please lift your hands up as much as possible.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Inhale, lift your left arm overhead, and put your right hand on the floor for support. Exhale slowly, bend your upper body to the right, gently bending your right arm. 

Hold the side bend. Breathe deeply into your left rib cage to help deepen the stretch.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your body.
Inhale to expand through the ribs, exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Inhale, lift your right arm overhead, and put your left hand on the floor for support. Exhale slowly, bend your upper body to the left, gently bending your left arm. 

Hold the side bend. Breathe deeply into your right rib cage to help deepen the stretch.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your body.
Inhale to expand through the ribs, exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. Put your left hand on your right knee and your right hand behind you on the floor. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine and lift your chest. Exhale and twist your upper body to the right. 

Hold this position, allowing your spine to lengthen with each inhale and deepen the twist with each exhale.
name: SEATED SPINAL TWIST LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
Please keep your weight on your hips; don’t shift it to your left arm.
Please don’t let your hips off the floor.
Please don’t tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the twist.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. Put your right hand on your left knee and your left hand behind you on the floor. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine and lift your chest. Exhale and twist your upper body to the left. 

Hold this position, allowing your spine to lengthen with each inhale and deepen the twist with each exhale.
name: SEATED SPINAL TWIST RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
Please keep your weight on your hips; don’t shift it to your right arm.
Please don’t let your hips off the floor.
Please don’t tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the twist.

introduce:
Sit with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. 

Put your hands behind you on the floor, and keep your fingers pointed backward. 

Slightly bend your elbows to feel the stretch in the front of your shoulders.
name: ANTERIOR SHOULDER STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep enough distance between your hands and hips so you can feel the stretch.
Please pull your shoulders back.

introduce: Stand in front of a wall with your hands against the wall. Slowly step back and slide your hands down until your upper body is parallel to the floor. \n\nPush your hands forward into the wall as you pull your hips away from the wall. Transfer your weight into your feet. Hold this position.
name: DOWNWARD FACING DOG ON THE WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please put your feet under your hips to feel more stretch.
Take deep and steady breaths.
This exercise can elongate your spine and stretch your shoulders and legs.

introduce:
Kneel down and sit back on your heels. Support your hands on the floor in front of you. 

Push your pelvis forward, and keep your lumbar region still. 

Inhale, and round your upper back. Exhale, and pull your chest out. Repeat the exercise.
name: THORACIC SPINE CAT COW

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your lumbar region still during exercise.
Inhale as you round your upper back, and exhale as you pull your chest out.
This exercise can mobilize your upper back.
